## Specific task description

Task instruction: Direct the right arm to click the red toggle switch

Task description: The object is the red rocker switch in a gray housing labeled ON/OFF at the left of the current image. Use the right arm to press the rocker fully into its switched position.

Success criteria: The right arm presses the red rocker to near the end of its maximum rotation travel. Merely touching its surface or moving it slightly does not count.

## Execution tips

- When the right arm approaches the left side of the image, use space in front of the switch and narrow the gripper opening appropriately. Leave clearance for fingers and their bases to reduce sweeping collisions with the gray frame and bottle behind the switch.
- Prefer pressing the raised end of the seesaw with the fingers together, at a point slightly in from the end and away from the middle. This preserves leverage for rotation and reduces slipping or catching on the frame.
- Apply small inward pressure normal to the contacted press surface while watching rocker rotation. If the fingertip is blocked but the rocker does not move, adjust the contacting end or point rather than continuously pressing against the housing or stop.
